scope: All 110 live v019 occurrences in the inherited suščestv-/suščstv-/sušt- existence, essential, and essence families.
choice: Replace 53 existence forms with the official type-1 obstajati paradigm, recast present 'vorhandene Literatur' as O sučej literaturi, normalize 54 essential forms to the official sučstven- paradigm, and normalize two essence phrases to v sučnosti.
motivation: The inherited family mixed malformed Russian/Bulgarian-shaped sųtstvovati forms, several competing sušt-/suščst-/suščestv- spellings, and incorrect agreement. The official type-1 entries provide distinct cross-Slavic forms for existence, current/present, essential, and essence; applying those distinctions removes a dominant-language calque without collapsing different meanings.
alternatives_rejected: Retain or regularize sųtstvovati/sųtstvo; the official dictionary marks these type 3 with an RU/BG source profile.
Use obstajajučej for vorhandene Literatur; the source means present/current literature, for which official sųći gives sučej.
Flatten v suštnosti to an adverb; the German construction denotes essence and is preserved as the noun phrase v sučnosti.
Apply a substring replacement; that could corrupt separate otsutstvuje/absence forms and agreement-sensitive endings.
